title: Contrastive Clustering: Toward Unsupervised Bias Reduction for Emotion and Sentiment Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the overestimation of anger and negative sentiment in neural network classifiers caused by topic-specific distractor tokens (e.g., controversial COVID-19 terms). The bias is evaluated by comparing the performance (F1 scores) of original versus debiased classifiers on sentences hand-annotated for bias propensity, and by calculating the variance in estimated emotion prevalence across specific discussion topics compared to human annotations.
